finalText:
Fixed. Two real bugs from the bump, buried under the noise.

`options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands options as `retryCount`. Fixed to match.

`retryPolicy.js` threw when a flag was `undefined`. The new config loader leaves unset flags that way instead of `false`. Now it treats unset as disabled.

Build now finishes clean, 0 errors, 8 warnings, all deprecation noise.
